correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=2 the window covers exactly three consecutive entries. The three short Fourier polynomials are A+Bzeta, B+Azeta^2 and zeta(A+Bzeta), giving full intensity invariants S and P; these agree for (a,b) and (b,a) when a,b>0. The support gaps alternate 1,2 and there are zeros every third coordinate. Frequencies recover S and P exactly (d>=6), and the restricted fiber comes from the two roots of X^2-SX+|P|^2. Reconstructed definitions, all quantifiers, boundary cases, and exact-checker outputs.

originality.rationale: The first-public 2022 STFT work leaves the sharp L/2-separated question as a conjecture. Its previously constructed periodic exceptions use a single occupied residue; the present 2-of-3 periodic support is connected, meets the half-window separation threshold and contradicts the unrestricted 2024 positive statement. The restricted two-orbit classification is proved via a quadratic invariant. Searches and comparison against similar published cyclic STFT records found no equivalent covering claim; historical priority remains provisional.
